bots.note: House example, not an AI-model entry. Chooses uniformly from the legal moves.

bots.name: Sample Greedy
bots.note: House example, not an AI-model entry. Searches one ply for material, checks and mate, with random tie-breaking. Preserves repetition and move-limit context.

bots.note: House example, not an AI-model entry. Uses iterative-deepening alpha-beta, piece-square tables and MVV-LVA ordering with an approximately 300 ms search budget. Clock-budgeted results may vary by device.
